name: Audit retest: invalid login returns auth error
description: Use the local app only. Enter ff-audit-invalid@example.com and invalid-audit-password. Do not use or create an account. Capture request URL, method, status, content type and sanitized response.

planSteps.description: Navigate to /login on the local app. Fill email with ff-audit-invalid@example.com and password with invalid-audit-password, then click Sign in.

Verify the browser stays on /login and displays an authentication error such as Invalid email or password. Verify the network request is POST /api/auth/login with HTTP 401, JSON content type, and no HTML or secrets.
